meta.heatMethod: heat = 100 x (0.75 x minmax(log10(1+repoStars)) + 0.25 x exp(-daysSincePush/300) + 0.05 if official), clamped to 0-100; minmax is taken over the repositories in this list; candidates are drawn round-robin across repositories so one aggregator repo cannot dominate
meta.heatMethodZh: 热度 = 所属仓库 Star（在本榜仓库区间内做对数归一，占 75%）+ 最近推送时间（指数衰减，占 25%），官方来源加 5 分；条目按热度降序，rank 即榜单名次。候选按仓库轮流取样，避免单个聚合仓霸榜。Star 属于仓库而非单个 SKILL.md，用于横向比较量级；因此同一仓库下的条目热度相同。

items.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

items.description: Classify a skills CLI pull request from its description and patch, while respecting existing labels.

items.name: triage
items.description: Identify focused, evidence-backed skills CLI bug fixes worth quuu's attention.

items.name: a11y-audit
items.description: Use for any accessibility audit or a11y fix (WCAG 2.2 A/AA, color contrast, compliance report, CI check) in React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte or HTML. Scans with a11y_scanner.py and checks contrast with contrast_checker.py, then fixes and re-verifies.

items.name: adversarial-reviewer
items.description: Tough, critical review of a diff or PR before merge, through hostile reviewer personas that catch shared blind spots. Use whenever the user wants a change torn apart, a harsh second opinion, or a self-review felt too agreeable.

items.name: aeo
items.description: Use when content should be cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude or Gemini (answer engine optimization), before rewriting it. Scores E-E-A-T and structure with aeo_audit.py, rewrites with aeo_optimizer.py and logs citations with citation_tracker.py.

items.name: agent-designer
items.description: Design multi-agent systems (supervisor, swarm, pipeline) and tool schemas; find bottlenecks in run logs. Use whenever agents split work or a run is slow or costly. Not for Claude Code workflow files (workflow-builder).

items.name: agent-harness
items.description: Use when an agent should drive a goal in one of this repo's domains to a verified close, before starting the work. Compiles the goal into a task plan with goal_compiler.py and runs it through loop_controller.py, which verifies each task, caps retries and escalates.

items.name: agent-launcher-orchestrator
items.description: Use when someone wants to build, launch, grade or schedule a Claude Managed Agent in their own Anthropic account ('build me an agent', 'run this nightly'). Reads the session goal, routes with goal_router.py and compiles the loop with loop_compiler.py.
